code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = max((value for value in counts if value != background), key=lambda value: counts[value])
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    motif = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _, _ in motif), max(r for r, _, _ in motif)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c, _ in motif), max(c for _, c, _ in motif)
    anchor_r, anchor_c = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr, mc in markers:
        for r, c, value in motif:
            rr, cc = mr + r - anchor_r, mc + c - anchor_c
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''

def extract_pairs(text):
    pairs=[]
    for n in (1,2):
        im=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', text)
        om=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', text)
        if not im or not om: continue
        h,w=map(int,im.groups()); ho,wo=map(int,om.groups())
        ilines=text[im.end():].splitlines()[:h]
        olines=text[om.end():].splitlines()[:ho]
        inp=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in ilines]
        out=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in olines]
        assert all(len(row)==w for row in inp), (n, [len(row) for row in inp])
        assert all(len(row)==wo for row in out), (n, [len(row) for row in out])
        pairs.append((inp,out))
    return pairs

def parse_all_pairs(text):
    pairs=[]
    for n in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8):
        im=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', text)
        om=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', text)
        if im and om:
            h,w=map(int,im.groups()); ho,wo=map(int,om.groups())
            inp=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in text[im.end():].splitlines()[:h]]
            out=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in text[om.end():].splitlines()[:ho]]
            pairs.append((inp,out))
    return pairs
